title: Double curlies are just an object

slides.say: You will see double curly braces in JSX. They are not special syntax.

slides.text: Outer {} = JSX window. Inner {} = an object.
slides.say: The outer braces open the JavaScript window. The inner braces are a plain object. Here, an inline style object.
Proof: pull the object into a variable, and you only need single braces.

slides.text: Style keys are camelCase: background-color → backgroundColor.
slides.say: One more thing. Inline style properties are camel case. Background dash color becomes backgroundColor.
